findings.title: index.json nightly_audits list missing most recent scan file 20260610T042614Z.json
findings.detail: .audits/index.json nightly_audits array lists 10 scan files ending at 2026-06-08T04:35:00Z.json. The file 20260610T042614Z.json exists on disk and contains 2 findings from the 2026-06-10 nightly audit run, but is absent from the nightly_audits list. The index.json last_updated field correctly shows 2026-06-10T04:26:14Z, which is the timestamp of the missing file, proving the audit ran but the nightly_audits list was not updated. Any tool that reads nightly_audits to enumerate past scans will miss the most recent audit.
findings.fix_sketch: Append '20260610T042614Z.json' to the nightly_audits array in .audits/index.json.

findings.title: plan.md schema category enum missing cosmetic
findings.detail: plan.md line 84 shows the findings schema with category field as 'logic|assumption|overconfidence|risk|redo' — missing the 'cosmetic' value. rubric.json (the canonical authority for severities and categories) defines 'cosmetic' as a valid category. Production scan files in .audits/ include findings with category:'cosmetic'. The schema in plan.md is the load-bearing reference for implementers and its category enum is incomplete, which could lead implementers to reject or incorrectly classify cosmetic findings.
findings.fix_sketch: Change 'logic|assumption|overconfidence|risk|redo' to 'logic|assumption|overconfidence|risk|redo|cosmetic' in the findings schema on line 84 of plan.md.
